01 / THE STUDIOROOTED IN AL QUOZ

BUILT FOR
YOUR EVERYDAY.

CURB imagines a modern men’s barbershop in Al Quoz, Dubai’s creative district. Industrial in spirit and relaxed by design, it’s a place for a good conversation and a cut that feels like you.

Every visit starts with a consultation. The shape, length and finish are considered around your routine — then brought together with clean lines, careful detail and styling you can make your own.
